title: Post Office Letters
shareTitle: Post Office Letters — Write, Stamp, Send!
description: Help friendly customers send and pick up real mail by forming lowercase names, choosing picture stamps, and matching each addressed envelope to its person.
learningGoals: Practice ordered lowercase manuscript formation with broad, forgiving guide paths
Write familiar short names from left to right
Experience print as functional information that gets a real letter to the right person
interactionModel: a continuous three-customer mail shift: welcome a sender, trace every lowercase letter of a recipient name, choose a picture stamp, tap or slide the addressed envelope into the mail chute, then match and hand it to the recipient at pickup
feedbackModel: earned strokes remain visible; gentle model-and-retry guidance replaces failure; the envelope preserves the exact lowercase HTML name; the smiling chute, customer reactions, postage art, recorded teacher voice, tactile sound effects, and a final sparkling post-office celebration reward every completed route

modes.title: Mail Shift
modes.skill: use lowercase names to send and collect functional mail
